segments.text: Hello and welcome to this MOOC massive open online course on bio risk management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习这门关于生物风险管理的 MOOC，也就是大规模开放在线课程。

segments.text: Today I have made this video especially for the participants of this particular MOOC.
segments.zh: 今天我专门为这门 MOOC 的学员制作了这段视频。

segments.text: So I am wearing what is known as personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 我现在穿着的就是所谓的个人防护装备。

segments.text: So I have a Tyvek suit, I have gloves and as you can see I have taped these gloves to my Tyvek suit
segments.zh: 我穿着一套 Tyvek 防护服，戴着手套，大家可以看到，我用胶带把手套和 Tyvek 防护服粘在一起，

segments.text: in order to prevent a breach of containment at this location.
segments.zh: 以防止这个部位出现防护失效。

segments.text: Okay, this Tyvek suit is required when you are handling fluids.
segments.zh: 好，处理液体时需要穿这种 Tyvek 防护服。

segments.text: Especially in today's example I will be handling body fluids or VTM, viral transport media derived samples.
segments.zh: 特别是在今天的示例中，我要处理体液或者 VTM，也就是病毒运输培养基中的样本。

segments.text: So I have to wear this suit in order to protect myself in case of a spill.
segments.zh: 所以我必须穿上这套防护服，以便在发生泄漏时保护自己。

segments.text: As I mentioned earlier in my video on the powered air purified respirator,
segments.zh: 正如我之前在关于动力送风过滤式呼吸器的视频中提到的，

segments.text: I have my battery pack over here and I have followed through with the SOP
segments.zh: 我的电池组在这里，而且我在穿戴个人防护装备时，

segments.text: which is an administrative control over here when I don't obey my protective equipment EPEs.
segments.zh: 已经遵循了标准操作规程，这里的标准操作规程就是一种管理控制。

segments.text: So now we are all set to go.
segments.zh: 现在我们一切准备就绪。

segments.text: I am going to zip up this but before that I am going to wear my powered air purified respirator.
segments.zh: 我要把这个拉链拉上，但在这之前，我要先戴上动力送风过滤式呼吸器。

segments.text: So I am going to wear my respirator now.
segments.zh: 现在我来戴呼吸器。

segments.text: So the respirator goes on top of my head.
segments.zh: 呼吸器戴在头顶上。

segments.text: It sits there and I turn on my power.
segments.zh: 把它放好，然后打开电源。

segments.text: My power tickles before I seal it.
segments.zh: 在密封之前，我先检查一下电源。

segments.text: So the power is now running.
segments.zh: 现在电源正在运行。

segments.text: I can see the power running.
segments.zh: 我可以看到电源在运行。

segments.text: Then I have to wear my shroud.
segments.zh: 然后我要戴上头罩。

segments.text: This is my shroud.
segments.zh: 这是我的头罩。

segments.text: So I am going to zip up this.
segments.zh: 现在我要把这个拉链拉上。

segments.text: So I put everything in.
segments.zh: 把所有东西都塞进去。

segments.text: The wires go in.
segments.zh: 电线也塞进去。

segments.text: And I zip up.
segments.zh: 然后拉上拉链。

segments.text: Now I am going to tie up this respirator.
segments.zh: 现在我要把这个呼吸器系紧。

segments.text: See I will do a deep check on my power.
segments.zh: 我再快速检查一下电源。

segments.text: So there is a lighting here which I can see.
segments.zh: 这里有指示灯，我可以看到。

segments.text: There are three lights.
segments.zh: 一共有三个灯。

segments.text: So when they are all lighted up it means I am powered up and ready to go into the laboratory workspace.
segments.zh: 当它们全部亮起时，就表示电源已开启，可以进入实验室工作区了。

segments.text: Now as a precaution I have to wear another set of gloves.
segments.zh: 作为预防措施，我还要再戴一副手套。

segments.text: So these are double gloves.
segments.zh: 这就是双层手套。

segments.text: I am going to wear this glove over my glove so that in case of a spill I can discard this glove.
segments.zh: 我要把这副手套戴在原来的手套外面，这样一旦发生泄漏，我就可以把这副手套丢掉。

segments.text: So I am going to wear this glove.
segments.zh: 现在我来戴这副手套。

segments.text: So I have basically a double glove.
segments.zh: 这样我基本上就戴上了双层手套。

segments.text: So now in the event of a spill, if I spill, I will take off my glove.
segments.zh: 现在，一旦发生泄漏，如果我洒出了东西，就会脱下手套。

segments.text: And I will replace it with another glove inside my laboratory space.
segments.zh: 然后在实验室内换上另一副手套。

segments.text: Now as a final check you need to look into the mirror to check everything is in order.
segments.zh: 最后，作为最终检查，你需要照镜子看看一切是否妥当。

segments.text: And your safety suit is in place.
segments.zh: 以及你的防护服是否穿戴到位。

segments.text: So that is how you basically don't wear personal protective equipment prior to entry into the lab.
segments.zh: 这基本上就是进入实验室之前穿戴个人防护装备的方法。

segments.text: That is about the video.
segments.zh: 这段视频就到这里。

segments.text: Thank you very much for watching.
segments.zh: 非常感谢观看。

segments.text: I am going to go in now.
segments.zh: 我现在要进去了。

segments.text: Stay bio safe.
segments.zh: 请注意生物安全。
